name: Flight Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You use transmutation items to fly long distances with your whole party.

Prerequisite(s): Flight Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Flight Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. You can force the item to cast overland flight by spending 2 daily uses of the feat or mass fly by spending 3 daily uses. If you also expend one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of the selected spell instead. You add ½ your mythic tier to your ability modifier on Fly skill checks while the selected spell lasts.
